title: Three broad value families on fruit
alt_text: An upper-left lamp illuminates fruit with a broad light area, a visible middle turning plane, and a dark form shadow clipped to the fruit. A separate cast shadow rests to the right on the table.
caption: Squint for three broad value families, then check the cast shadow against your setup.

provenance.work_title: Three broad value families on fruit
provenance.license_or_attribution: Original course diagram; no source-book illustration was copied.

review_notes: The three broad value regions are labeled in text as well as color. The dark form shadow is clipped to the fruit silhouette; a separate cast shadow touches the base and extends right, away from the lamp.
